summary: Full backend + code review testing for 3 previously reported bugs: (1) Tax proportionality, (2) Purchases saving to DB, (3) Live Sales Widget periodic refresh. All 27 tests PASSED. All 3 fixes confirmed working correctly.

minor.issue: MAX_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT is hardcoded at $50,000 in createOrder. For the high-price test event ($55,000 ticket), grandTotal = $62,100.18 which exceeds the limit. This means the $55,000 high-price event CANNOT be purchased through Stripe checkout (would get AMOUNT_TOO_HIGH error). Note: calculate-order (preview) works fine since it doesn't have this limit.
minor.priority: MEDIUM - only affects very high-price events

action_items: OPTIONAL: Review MAX_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT ($50,000) limit in stripeController.js createOrder handler (line 322). The high-price test event ($55,000 ticket) would fail checkout with AMOUNT_TOO_HIGH error. If $55k+ ticket sales are expected, consider raising or removing this cap.
critical_code_review_comments: TAX FIX CONFIRMED: priceCalculator.js calculates tax as taxableAmount * (tax_rate / 100). For $200 ticket at 5% → $10 tax. For $400 (2 tickets) at 5% → $20 tax. Tax is correctly proportional.
PURCHASE PERSISTENCE CONFIRMED: 54 paid registrations in DB. 4 from 2026-02-25 (Tyler Anskkjjk). Purchases are saving correctly.

DASHBOARD PERIODIC REFRESH CONFIRMED: Lines 94 (userIdRef=useRef), 131-147 (useEffect with setInterval(30000) + visibilitychange + cleanup). Stale closure avoided by using userIdRef.current instead of currentUser state.
LIVE REVENUE WIDGET CONFIRMED: useMemo, isPaidStatus/isRefundedStatus filters, 48h feed, timestamp-based filtering, LIVE indicator, empty state has no red border.
HIGH-PRICE EVENT TAX CONFIRMED: $55,000 × 5% = $2,750 tax (exactly). grandTotal = $62,100.18.
GRAND TOTAL RECONCILIATION CONFIRMED: $200 subtotal + $10 tax + $10.44 platformFee + $6.69 stripeFee = $227.13 ✓

rca_of_issues.tax_bug: Tax was previously a flat $5. Fix in priceCalculator.js now correctly applies: taxAmount = taxableAmount * (tax_rate / 100). Verified: $200@5%=$10, $400@5%=$20, $55000@5%=$2750.
rca_of_issues.purchase_not_saving: Confirmed resolved: 54 paid registrations exist in DB including 4 from 2026-02-25. The stripeController.js insert logic at line 558 correctly persists registrations.
rca_of_issues.live_widget_not_updating: Fixed by adding periodic refresh in Dashboard.tsx: useRef(userIdRef) for userId to avoid stale closures, setInterval(doRefresh, 30000) for 30s polling, visibilitychange listener to refresh on tab re-focus. Proper cleanup on unmount (clearInterval + removeEventListener).
